title: Fourier Transform
subtitle: Analysis · Signal processing
summary: Decomposes a time-domain signal into its frequency components.
detail:
\[ \hat{F}(\xi) = \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} F(t)\,e^{-2\pi i t\xi}\,dt \]

The inverse is \(F(t)=\int\hat{F}(\xi)e^{2\pi it\xi}d\xi\). Parseval's theorem: \(\int|F|^2=\int|\hat{F}|^2\) (energy is conserved). Some conventions use angular frequency \(\omega\) instead of \(\xi\), inserting factors of \(2\pi\) differently.
